academics.statement: Students may contact their faculty advisor for academic-related assistance.
academics.recommended_action: Contact your faculty advisor for academic-related assistance and guidance.

attendance.statement: Students should follow the minimum attendance requirement prescribed by university regulations.
attendance.location: A Block (Faculty Advisor) or D Block (Administrative Office)
attendance.recommended_action: Consult official university regulations or reach out to your faculty advisor. Note that specific percentage numbers are not provided in the knowledge base.

examinations.statement: Timetables and notifications are published through official university channels.
examinations.recommended_action: Monitor official university channels for timetables and notifications. Specific dates are published exclusively through those channels.
examinations.source: Office of the Controller of Examinations

placements.statement: Students should contact the Placement Department for training and placement-related information.
placements.recommended_action: Contact the Placement Department at L Block for training schedules and placement-related queries.

library.statement: Students can access library resources according to library timings and regulations.
library.recommended_action: Visit B Block to access library resources in accordance with official library timings and regulations.

hostel.statement: Hostel-related complaints should be submitted to Hostel Administration.
hostel.recommended_action: Submit your complaint directly to Hostel Administration at the Hostel Zone.

administration.statement: Students should contact the respective administrative office for certificates and student records.
administration.recommended_action: Visit the Administrative Office at D Block for certificates and student records.
administration.source: Office of the Registrar & Student Records

events.statement: University event announcements are shared through the official communication channel.
events.recommended_action: Check the official university communication channel for verified event announcements.

policy_guidelines.unknown_fallback_statement: I couldn't find verified information about this in the available university information.
policy_guidelines.missing_data_notice: Do not invent attendance percentages, exam dates, fees, contact numbers, email addresses, office timings or other university policies. If the information is not present in the knowledge base, clearly state that it is unavailable.
